item.description:
Features:
  • Grok Bot usage now appears on the Grok Build & Bot tab instead of the Cursor tab. If you had assigned Cursor's xAI usage to Grok Bot by hand, check that choice.
  • When Syrtis knows which captured account agy is signed into, the main Antigravity card reads that account's quota (label OAUTH) instead of running agy. If agy's sign-in changes, that round runs agy as before.
Fixes:
  • Rotating, panning or zooming the 3D chart no longer stutters.
  • Dragging the Glass tint slider no longer stutters.
  • A limits card with an error no longer shows empty "No data" rows under the message.

Features:
  • Glass tint (macOS 27): a slider tints the popover's glass, darker in dark mode and lighter in light mode, so its text stays readable over the windows behind it. It's in Settings -> Dashboard -> Glass tint and in Quick settings (slider icon at the top right of the popover). Thanks @Lanternko.
  • Scrolling over the 3D chart now scrolls the page; pinch or Command + scroll zooms, and a hint on the chart says so. On macOS 27, closing the popover returns you to the app you were in. Thanks @blankhoney.
Fixes:
  • Reset on the 3D chart now returns to the starting angle.
  • Option-drag and right-drag on the 3D chart now follow the pointer up and down.
  • Turning off Cursor usage sync while a sync was waiting to start no longer sends a request, and Settings now says when the downloaded usage couldn't be deleted (restart Syrtis to retry).

Features:
  • Cursor usage without the tokscale CLI: Syrtis downloads your usage itself, using the Cursor app's login on this Mac. A card on the Overview asks first (only if Cursor is installed); after Continue it syncs at launch and every 30 minutes. The login goes only to cursor.com and is never saved; Syrtis stores the date, model, token counts, cost and conversation ID of each request, and turning it off deletes them. Settings -> General -> Cursor usage sync has the switch and Sync Now. If the tokscale CLI already has Cursor data, Settings asks before Syrtis uses its own sync, so usage is counted once.
Fixes:
  • Cursor usage synced by a recent tokscale CLI (saved as usage.json) is now read. Thanks @whes1015.

Fixes:
  • Syrtis kept more than half of a CPU core busy while the popover was open: the activity light redrew the whole popover up to about 120 times a second, and the popover's content ran unseen from launch. With demo data and the popover open, the main thread alone used 57.5% of one core before; the whole app now uses 2.1%. The short spike each time Syrtis rebuilds its usage totals (every Data refresh interval, or every 5 minutes while an agent is active if that is sooner) is unchanged. Thanks @miyago9267.
  • An unused Antigravity window read "Pace unavailable · invalid quota data", or started a new window on every update. It now reads "Learning reset duration" until you use it.
  • An Antigravity account on a paid Google AI plan was labeled Free. The card shows the paid plan's name, and agy's merged main card shows it too.
  • With automatic capture on, an account agy signed in to during a capture could be shown with the previous account's email.
  • An extra Claude account's window card counted usage of another configured account kept inside its folder.
  • The Grok tab now shows Grok Bot's window card when only Grok Bot is set up.
  • Switching off OpenCode under Settings -> Dashboard -> Agent limits no longer hides the other quota cards on the OpenCode tab.
  • OpenCode Go's "Rolling" window is now translated in Chinese.

Features:
  • The window card can switch between accounts. With two or more accounts with live windows (extra Claude config folders, captured Antigravity accounts), a row of account buttons switches the card's windows, curve and history; the choice is remembered. The main account's button shows its email. Window names are shorter, and button rows wrap when they do not fit.
  • Antigravity has a window card and window history. Its local usage area reads "Local usage can't be attributed to this account yet." When agy is signed in to a captured account, the main card shows that account's curve and history. Weekly and 5-hour windows draw a curve from their first reading.
Fixes:
  • With automatic capture off, capturing the account agy is using merges it into one card until agy next refreshes its sign-in, usually within an hour. Turn automatic capture on to keep it merged.
  • The Antigravity card could stay on "not logged in" after one slow agy run. A timeout is now retried after 15 minutes, and the card shows agy's own error.
  • Claude's Designs and Daily Routines windows no longer show an empty history if Anthropic reports them in its newer limits format.

New:
  • Brand logos for the Cline, jcode, MiMo Code, and gjc tabs, instead of a letter badge.
Improved:
  • The client-tab row now scrolls with a plain vertical mouse wheel, so a mouse without a horizontal-scroll wheel can reach every tab.
Fixes:
  • Antigravity CLI now shows the shared Antigravity quota instead of an empty or duplicate limit card.

New:
  • Tracks five more local AI coding tools: Cline, Antigravity CLI, jcode, MiMo Code, and gjc.
Improved:
  • More accurate cost and per-tool attribution across AI token usage.
  • Corrected Codex usage counts for forked and sub-agent sessions.
  • Antigravity CLI usage is now dated per turn, so the live view and daily totals reflect when each turn actually happened.
Fixes:
  • The app no longer crashes if the usage parser hits an unexpected error.
  • More reliable live usage updates, including for the newly added tools.
